$comment: Maps a Still release version to the work it carries, so a reader can tell which
build contains which journey. The published artifact is the GitHub tag archive
of Jongtae/Still, consumed by scripts/install.sh and by this repository's own
Formula/agentos.rb. No Still release is published yet; v0.1.0 is the first.
Releases v1.0.4-v1.4.1 belong to the private predecessor Jongtae/agentos and
they are not Still releases. See docs/release.en.md.

published.carries: First Still release, restarted at 0.1.0 from the predecessor's in-tree 1.4.2; milestone v0.1.0 (#4, #45, #46, #48, #51). It carries the predecessor source imported on 2026-10-17 and the repository transition: public entry points, installer and development references point at Jongtae/Still, the Homebrew formula lives in this repository (brew tap jongtae/still https://github.com/Jongtae/Still), and the agentos command, data directory and AGENTOS_* variables are kept for compatibility. It also carries the fixes merged before preparation: WebKit process start before the first navigation deadline (#5), closing a disconnected web client without replaying (#6), the procedure-library replacement message (#7), a pinned turn clock in Work regression tests (#9), recovered steps told apart from unresolved failures (#14), the PR-body reuse review guide (#59), an incomplete calendar request handed to the AI worker (#63), no receive failure reported for one Telegram connection reset (#65), and the owner-model upkeep tests kept on their Works' clock (#67).
published.observed: Published by the release workflow after owner approval. The served tag archive SHA-256 was measured twice and matched; Homebrew formula PR https://github.com/Jongtae/Still/pull/72 merged after its macOS formula install and brew test passed. The owner's installed upgrade was observed on 2026-10-18 on macOS (Homebrew at /opt/homebrew): the first `brew install jongtae/still/agentos` stopped because the predecessor tap's formula of the same name was still tapped; after `brew uninstall agentos` and `brew untap jongtae/agentos` (docs/QUICKSTART.md), it installed `agentos 0.1.0` (`brew list --versions agentos`), and `agentos start` kept the existing data directory, reported the codex sign-in, the model and its tool calls and Judgment AI as checked, and served http://127.0.0.1:8787/. The owner did not run `brew test` or `scripts/quickstart_install_check.py`, and did not observe a background-service restart; two family instances were not reachable at that start.
published.not_claimed: No install of this tag archive was observed before publication; the publish workflow's macOS brew install/brew test and the installer smoke run only after the tag exists, and the owner's own upgrade is not yet recorded. Installs from the predecessor's Jongtae/homebrew-agentos tap are not moved to this tap by this release. Tests and CI do not prove live external integrations, model-dependent behavior or a background service surviving a restart.

published.carries: Minor release after v0.1.0; milestone v0.2.0 (#258, #262, #271) and everything merged to main since v0.1.0. New for the owner: work mode, an owner-switched mode in which nothing a Work produced is sent out and no undeclared destination is reached (#208); owner-declared intranet destinations admitted by the private-address guards, with every DNS answer of a declared API host checked and pinned and a code run's exact port checked (#209); Claude Code and Codex run through Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry or Azure OpenAI (#211); Memory kept as append + invalidate, with the upkeep ending rows by id and dated facts ending (#220); every reader given the owner's earlier words for the request and the whole owner profile (#221, #217); working lessons kept in one bounded, revisable notes document (#19); held values found in outbound tool text shown in the information-use audit (#167); a worker-drafted connection disconnect the owner confirms (#183); calendar requests through the worker draft tools with the exact-preview approval kept (#22); analysis-method skills and bounded header reads (#32); a bounded load-more for lazy lists in browser reads (#11); an offer to start Still at login at the end of first setup (#105); independent public reads of one turn run at the same time (#16); company tools through the owner's own local MCP servers, with the Codex server keeping its own HOME and PATH and Claude Code turns started in the default permission mode so Still decides each call (#210); and typing on the phone keyboard straight into the Mac login window from the phone sign-in page (#293). Judgment reads owner acts and situations in context instead of keyword rules (#170, #172, #173, #174). Secret handling: a retired secret is never recalled and the early plan's reads are audited, also when a Work parks or the plan is asked again (#258, #275, #279); exports redact JSON-escaped secrets and rebuild the search index (#271). Fixes include the Telegram Bot API transport on httpx2 and replies queued while Telegram is unreachable (#121, #123), usable Google credentials through renewal failures and write 401s (#8, #246), decoded Gmail bodies (#150), browser typing, press and stop fixes (#12, #102, #103, #244), the iPhone profile token (#13), non-ASCII case folding in result search (#203), an FTS5 statement re-prepared after a concurrent schema change (#262), locale catalog fixes (#10, #235), the phone sign-in link message saying how its session ended and the prompt dropping its buttons while the phone link drives the window (#255), and outbound audit records only after a transport hand-off (#233).
published.observed: Tagged, released and measured by the release workflow after owner approval (run 40111986005): the served tag archive SHA-256 was measured twice and matched, and measured again twice outside the workflow on 2026-10-25 with the same value. The workflow then stopped at the Homebrew formula PR https://github.com/Jongtae/Still/pull/298, whose validate failed on a traceability test that did not allow the formula before this record (#301, fixed by #302); the owner merged #298 after its checks, including the macOS 15 and 26 (Apple silicon) formula install and brew test, passed on its updated head. A full re-run stops at the existing tag, so this record was written with scripts/dev/release.py record outside the workflow (#286). On an Intel MacBook the owner's Homebrew install did not complete (2026-10-25); the cause is not yet diagnosed, and CI has no Intel Homebrew install. The owner's own installed upgrade is not yet recorded.

In particular, no live Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry or Azure OpenAI run, no live intranet destination, and no work-mode session on a company network is claimed by this release. No live company MCP server is claimed; #210 was observed locally without a model. The Mattermost and Slack surfaces (#213, #214) are not in it. Known open defects: four predecessor fixes not yet ported, including asking for the current location before using a fitting saved place (#201), and a desktop-only page cropped in the phone-sized login window (#254).

published.carries: Minor release after v0.2.0; milestone v0.3.0 (27 closed issues) and everything merged to main since v0.2.0. New for the owner: the owner's Slack direct message as a conversation surface over Socket Mode (#214) and the owner's Mattermost direct message, outbound only (#213), with one owner across messengers for connectors and current context (#319), Slack answers sent as Slack Markdown (#372), the Slack thread status saying what Still is doing (#446) and every chat surface's worker told it answers in a chat (#375); a tool-free independent question answered while another Work runs (#17), and a shorter critical path for short replies (#309); messages sent mid-answer steer the running worker natively, a reply is never delivered with a steer its worker did not see, and the owner is told what happened to each one (#308), and a mid-Work correction reaches planning, not only the running worker (#428); a subscription CLI update no longer stops Still: the installed Codex or Claude Code binary is qualified locally in the background instead of against an in-code version list (#346, #344, #349), and on Linux and WSL a subscription CLI qualifies by those probes instead of a macOS-only list (#450); recall of earlier conversation exchanges, both sides (#205); a separate opt-in Gmail modify grant for organising the mailbox, with no send (#355), and mail results that carry a Gmail web link the owner can open (#497); Google Calendar changes made by the owner's AI through the Calendar API with Google's own refusal reason visible, replacing the fixed calendar draft and approval flow, with Still forcing no invitation e-mails (#432); forget and delete keep a record instead of erasing and cover the transcript (#367), and teach the owner model nothing (#380); the owner's stated plans remembered as durable facts (#398), a once-a-day look back over recent requests that finds facts first, then tidies quietly, raises only what the owner relies on and reads only the owner's own words (#402, #416, #423, #424, #425, #429), dated event records in each brief (#442), 내 기록 marking what the look back wrote (#443), an answer showing the memory it relied on by using it (#426), and every remembered fact saying what it rests on, the owner's own words or an inference, so a sentence the assistant wrote is never saved as something the owner said (#493); one shared voice for every owner-facing generator and Still's standing instructions sent to Codex as developer instructions (part of #198); the owner told what was understood and the plan before a long Work, and what the worker found while it works (#407), plan previews and interim messages that read like a person (#452), and a waiting bubble that names the launched AI and model (#458), shows only dots on Telegram (#445) and, with /dev on, shows them while the Work runs (#477); Claude Code sub-agents run inside the worker's turn and are shown by name in the waiting bubble, with the answer arriving only when they are done (#460); the worker brief states the Work's remaining allowance (#468), a Work that stops at its budget mid-progress offers Continue (#471), the token usage each CLI reports is recorded and shown on the Work (#467), and the worker catalogue shows each model's measured speed and usage next to its task size (#473, #498); a terminal first run that leads straight into a conversation, with Telegram connected from that conversation and its token typed hidden (#438); the web management screen with connection status first, files and permissions, memory first, and scheduled and diagnostics entry points (#390), settings panes that show what is on and add a connection by type through one dialog (#474), and site login reporting what it saved (#488); a judgment that may ask for the engine's strongest model, never a pinned name (#420), and the Judgment model chosen by measured speed among the qualified candidates, with Settings naming it, its median and p95 and the candidates compared (#472, #465), a failed candidate naming the case it failed (#470) and a Codex judgment taken at turn.completed (#469); a missing connection on the CLI route parks the Work and hands over the link, and a slot's write connection is offered in conversation (#363, #366); independent effect-free reads run concurrently on the CLI route (#386); and per-Work tool-attempt and browser-step caps raised to 200 (#353). Fixes include the login window opened at the full sign-in address (#340), a desktop-only page widening the phone sign-in window instead of being cropped (#254), predecessor browser and location fixes ported (#201), connector handoff, resume refusals and folder-permission lines in the owner's language (#242), the held-value comparison saying when it was cut off (#245), direct-route history labelled as earlier Works and a typed awaiting-the-owner fact (#240), evaluation in context with critique treated as advice (#202), the 8-character redaction floor applied to API responses so provider ids are not corrupted (#368), stored secrets redacted in the service so bridge text and method_gap notes are not withheld (#369), an attempt that could not be confirmed reported as such instead of as an irreversible action that ran (#387), the early plan kept when only the clock moved during routing (#384), watch and preparation fixes (#393, #394, #395, #404, #412), planner effort weighed against observed time (#410), a needed question about a missing request detail not treated as a prerequisite (#406), earlier scheduled goals shown as saved task context (#360), a resumed Work's request shown once in recall (#361), Still bridge calls counted apart from the CLI's own actions (#377), an interim message to the owner no longer blocking re-delegation (#466), and release workflow fixes for re-runs, the formula PR and milestone closing (#313, #301, #335). For development only, an AppWorld-based action sandbox for evaluations (#484).

published.carries: Minor release after v0.3.0; milestone v0.4.0 and everything merged to main since v0.3.0. Version 0.3.1 was skipped: its fixes ship here. New for the owner: one-time phone links (API secret input, remote login, family setup) open through a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel when ngrok is not configured, so no ngrok account is needed; Still downloads the pinned cloudflared 2026.10.7 into its own tool directory and runs it only if its SHA-256 matches, or uses one already installed, and work mode still refuses every tunnel, including a switch made while cloudflared is being downloaded (#523, #554); the owner's AI creates Gmail filters through a separate opt-in gmail-filters grant, and a filter that forwards mail is refused before the request leaves (#502); Settings shows Google access per service with the route in use instead of one row per grant (#535); a bundled first-conversations reference skill that opens with one easy start and learns owner facts only when a request needs them (#530); and the plan preview reads what each connection can do, so it no longer promises an action no connection can perform (#501). Fixes include Still's remaining owner-visible lines (settings conversation, chat modules, service, decision routes, agent runtime, local web server and the phone input page) shown in the owner's language (#514), first setup from the installer reading its questions from the terminal and ignoring keys typed before a question (#510), Still's own terminal lines shown in the terminal's language (#511), a terminal working line that keeps turning and shows how long Still has worked (#512), Telegram's waiting draft moved below a message the Work sends (#518), an API connection described plainly once and named briefly after (#519), a failed API secret link that says why and opens the input page on this Mac instead (#520), the Homebrew formula refusing Intel Macs up front and pointing to the one-line installer (#543), and owners pointed to the macOS login service from the terminal, --help, README and installer (#553). For development: patch releases from a maintenance line maint/X.Y in the release workflow (#533), a short release scope in validate for release-data pull requests (#508), and a shorter README and a redesigned homepage with setup steps and conversation examples (#539, #540, #558).

published.carries: Minor release after v0.4.0; milestone v0.5.0 and everything merged to main since v0.4.0. Version 0.4.1 was skipped: its fixes ship here. New for the owner: a preparation can be edited, paused, resumed or run now from the conversation and Settings (#575); a preparation repeats by an RFC 5545 rule (specific weekdays, monthly, until or count), and Settings edits its time with date-time pickers instead of ISO text (#580, #581); a plainly recurring request is offered as one repeating preparation in the reply, never again after the owner declines, and the daily look-back suggests a standing preparation when it sees a request repeated on separate days (#582, #583); the owner's AI can open a site's desktop version when a mobile user agent redirects it away, and Still keeps that choice per site (#572), which Settings lists and resets (#585); and code runs keep working on a machine without Node.js: Still downloads the pinned official Node.js 26.13.0 into its own tool directory and runs it only if its SHA-256 matches, and the Homebrew formula now depends on Homebrew's node (#593). Signing in from the phone through the one-time link works on a desktop-only sign-in page: the phone sees a phone-shaped picture, tapping a text field opens a visible input box with the phone's own keyboard (Korean included) whose text replaces the field's content only when the owner taps 넣기, and a QR code shown in the window opens its link when tapped or from a link button (#596, #602). Fixes include a repeating request becoming one recurring preparation with no duplicate proposals across Works (#574), the acceptance judgment reading the conversation so the owner's own schedule request needs no button (#573), Telegram never rewriting AI text through the line translator and showing fixed lines in the language the owner writes (#584), the Work context naming only recorded or shared browser sign-ins (#563), browser_sign_in deferring to the route rule for unconnected services (#565), the worker's route texts and the goal judgment knowing Still can take an API's keys (#567, #586), automatic phone sign-in showing a preparing notice before it sends the actual link, with a verified sign-in renewing the request's work budget so it continues without another owner message (#599), the per-Work model turn budget raised from 9 to 15 so a request judged short after two attempts gets the third attempt the orchestrator already allows (#601), and a bridge read-overlap test that no longer depends on a 30 ms timing window (#570). For development: astral-sh/setup-uv in CI and the release workflow bumped to v10.3.3 (#569). The preparations store gains columns through its automatic forward migration; python-dateutil becomes a direct dependency (already locked through arrow).

published.carries: Minor release after v0.5.0; milestone v0.6.0 and everything merged to main since v0.5.0. Version 0.5.1 was skipped: its fixes ship here. New for the owner: an on/off payment autonomy mode (자율 결제 모드), off by default, in which the owner's own AI completes payments and money movements without a per-action approval, also from a scheduled watch, with each payment recorded and told to the owner right after (#662); the owner's Still can talk with other AI agents over the A2A protocol, a peer is never treated as the owner, is registered from its Agent Card in Settings with nothing disclosed by default, and every exchange is readable and blockable (#651), and an owner whose Main AI is the Codex subscription CLI can let it answer those agents with exactly the peer-scoped tools (#673); the browser tool works on a Linux desktop through the pinned Chrome for Testing build, downloaded on first use and run only when its SHA-256 matches, with the Chromium sandbox required, and Linux keys live in the desktop keyring (#34); a site the owner signed in to through an identity provider is signed back in through that provider when the provider asks nothing, and is handed to the owner otherwise (#636); the owner can ask Still what it can do or be set to, developer mode is a setting the AI reads and changes, and /help lists every command (#705); the nightly look back can suggest a one-off reminder or preparation for a dated need (#638) and learn a working-notes lesson from misses across days (#496); and the phone login view zooms to and centres a desktop page's sign-in area (#707), opens the site's mobile version, and has a mobile/PC toggle (#709). The family sharing feature is removed (#657): startup archives its config records and renames its files idempotently, keeps owner data, and removes no agentos CLI command. Work semantics are unified: one Work budget the AI can see, one step counter and a loop guard (#620), one effect class per call and one continuation rule (#618, #627), one payment gate with action-bound approvals that stay open until settled while unattended runs only notify (#619), refusals that tell the model the real reason with gates that protected nothing removed (#617), and consumers that ask what a Work's status means through named predicates (#664). The outcome judgment sees the CLI worker's own search sources (#621) and this Work's completed effects, and a denial is re-judged once, never flipped (#674). Fixes include OpenAI API Work no longer failing with HTTP 400 on tool descriptions over 1024 characters (#629), sign-in resuming after a click whose navigation Still refused and the browser naming the real refusal reason (#610, #615), the login window returning to the site after a popup sign-in (#683), mobile first holding without failing on an app-only link (#643), a sign-in or connection wait ending partial on both routes (#690), a goal-reached Work not being partial because of failed steps that changed nothing (#656), the success floor recovering only the same invocation (#630), unknown-effect Works ending unknown on the direct route and in turn provenance (#663, #691), the CLI route storing a Work whose proposal awaits acceptance (#679), a Work's edit of its own unoffered proposal applying without a second ask (#702), the closing line after a partial answer coming from the outcome judgment (#631), scheduled runs keeping a finished reply, seeing their recorded schedule and their previous report (#671, #682, #692), a watch's until being inclusive and a changed end keeping its remaining slots (#701, #693), preparation proposals asking once with natural buttons (#645), a prepared result opening as what was promised with a bold title (#660, #666), a preparation's schedule line coming from the message catalog (#689), a superseded settings draft being withdrawn (#675), a reservation schedule edit confirmed by its name and both schedules (#653), and answers naming what a Work changed in the assistant's own voice (#648). For development: C15 looks outside first and adding a case to Still's machinery is Build (#612); the concept docs are consolidated (#35); the memory and dream experiment results are preserved (#642); and flaky MCP bridge, login and phone-window real-WebKit tests are fixed (#457, #684, #652). New optional extras a2a (a2a-sdk[http-server] 1.3.0, uvicorn; imported only once a peer is registered) and linux-browser (playwright 1.64.1); on Linux the base install now also depends on secretstorage for the desktop keyring. macOS dependencies are unchanged. New tables and settings arrive through the automatic forward migration.

unpublished.carries: Minor release after v0.6.0; milestone v0.7.0 and everything merged to main since v0.6.0. Version 0.6.1 was skipped: its fixes ship here. New for the owner: the owner's AI prepares ahead without being asked. Once a day it reads the day (calendar, the recent conversation, what is already scheduled and how earlier preparations turned out) and sets up the reading and research worth having ready (#780); what it sets up runs at once and is told afterwards with a cancel button instead of waiting for accept, and the nightly look back sets up work for the owner's standing interests (#717, #732, #755); something the owner entrusts to Still stays one entrusted line across replaced or restarted schedules, keeps the owner's lasting corrections, can be listed on request, gives a periodic account of itself, and stopping it stops everything under it (#798, #802); an agreed preparation keeps its schedule and promised reports across restarts, a watch can repeat in the same local window on eligible days, and a waiting or expired preparation tells the owner once (#797); a preparation cancelled by mistake can be restored with 취소 되돌리기 or by asking (#784); Still speaks in one voice: its fixed lines use the same 해요체 as AI-written replies, and one saved owner voice preference is read by every generator (#198), with a one-time conversational voice calibration offered after the first welcome (#348); Settings gives exact console steps for each connection value and shows a connected channel's stored values (#317), chooses a folder with the Mac's own folder dialog, and names a profile item in plain words (#390); the plan judgment answers directly when what it was given already answers (#749); and a request gets up to four attempts with the time and turns to run them, with worker routing choosing the route most likely to give the best result instead of the cheapest (#717). The Drive Picker (selected-file) connection is removed (#739): startup retires its stored slots and generated TLS files idempotently, settles any Work still waiting on it as failed with a normal-connection recovery message, and keeps owner data; the full-Drive connection is unchanged. With it the agentos drive-config command and the start option --drive-handoff-port are removed. A Work's status is derived from its recorded goal outcome and effect state, so the closing line, success reaction, Continue offers and procedure publication agree (#632). Fixes include a reply using the means it has, saying what it could not check and asking only when assuming would be wrong (#202, #197), resolving what the owner is unsure of instead of handing the check back (#751), an owner's button tap being in the conversation the next turn reads (#762), a watch using the function library its own request just wrote and keeping its whole plan while replacing the watch it changes (#764, #766), a failing saved function being the AI's to fix (#770), a refused preparation window naming the rule it broke and not blocking re-delegation (#785, #786), a browser step killed for not answering keeping Still's observation (#791), AI Works keeping a recorded provider's sign-in popup and a re-sign-in recorded as returned, not signed in (#696, #757), a payment-autonomy notice reading like the approval prompt (#777), run-state plain values no longer redacted for good or releasing a credential's retirement mark (#778, #792), a settings draft counting as shown when its confirmation was sent (#719), the Gmail slot naming mail_search (#720), an expired Drive connection offering to reconnect (#721), and the waiting draft no longer adding a “참, …” line (#795). Performance: effect-free reads of one turn overlap on the direct route (#16), secret redaction reads the Keychain once per secrets revision (#772), and a direct reply skips unused plan fields (#774). For development: AgentService responsibilities move into their own modules (#21), the judgment validation harness measures semantic quality, routing and latency on the shipped path (#42), the public READMEs are rewritten for first-time users (#729), and a remote-login test cleanup race is fixed (#681). No dependency changes. New tables and settings arrive through the automatic forward migration.
